title: Line sketch: Alien Portrait
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A muscular alien with large black eyes and sharp teeth gazes downward with a menacing expression. The creature's shiny, textured skin is highlighted with glossy reflections against a plain background (derived from painting #685).
